author: ihatesastodeal
title: Poor customer service
review_text: I am currently living abroad since 3 years. I was using esewa since it was open. When i was in nepal i have registered from my mobile number and it doesnot work here . Hence, I was using esewa web version. Since 6 months they asked me to reset the password. When i try to reset they ask for otp mobile verification. I cant access my old mobile number and i try to call and email them many time but also they havent respond me. So poor customer service. They should ask user before doing this.

title: Not accessible
review_text: This is great app for nepali users only in nepal but not for international user. Please make access for using from international countries to get benefits from this app. Thanks
